header.note: Every number below comes from a real command or test run in this integration worktree; nothing is asserted from memory.

receipts.trusted_receipt_resolver: YES (receipt_id -> ReceiptStore -> narrow TrustedExecutionReceipt; OutcomeService accepts ids only)
receipts.receipt_digest_semantics: native integrity/audit field; trust comes from the resolver + persistent store, never from a caller-provided digest (Brain recomputes for mutation detection)

observations.trusted_observation_resolver: YES (observation_id -> trusted native observation; tests fake the resolver)
observations.observation_fields: unified (contract json: ids, 4 identity bindings, attempt_started_at/observed_at, payload + digest, parser_status, truncated, source_adapter/binding, process metadata); native carries NO verified/business_success/expected_match authority

outcome_store.one_outcome_per_receipt: YES (store-level canonical instance; corrupt files rejected)

node_security.classification: pre-existing (3 low / 10 moderate / 13 high / 2 critical): node-tar via cacache (transitive) + xlsx (no fix). Verified: zero direct src imports of tar/cacache/xlsx in brain-server; none reach the outcome/evidence/approval runtime.

rust_security.quick_xml_windows_runtime_reachable: NO (verified fresh: cargo tree -i on the default x86_64-pc-windows-msvc target prints nothing for both quick-xml versions; 0.30.0 is a build-dependency of the X11-only xcb crate, 0.39.3 comes via plist/tauri-codegen/wayland-scanner (macOS/Linux/proc-macro) paths)

tests.cross_language: state 26 + observation 35 vectors, mismatch 0 on both suites
tests.synthetic_e2e: 6 cases automated (Rust native halves + Brain pipeline halves)

regressions.cp6_evidence_guard: PASS (296 Brain evidence+approval tests incl. cp6 adversarial oracle; Rust CP6 tests green in the full suite)
regressions.cp7_approval_risk: PASS (approval binding, durable replay, plan/approval single-use, consume-before-spawn, risk downgrade defense; Brain + Rust suites green)

false_success_audit.method: full-repo grep for success/succeeded/exit_code/BrokerExecutionResult/Outcome/verification/verification_plan across runtime sources (src only, not docs/tests); every runtime surface that could promote process success to business/task/goal/outcome success was classified

surfaces.classification: EXECUTION_ONLY (BrokerExecutionResult.success = process lifecycle only; feeds receipts, never verdicts)
SAFE_EXISTING (exit-0-gated machine parsing, fail closed, no verdicts)
SAFE_EXISTING (read-only aggregate; ipc_surface_tests freeze the registry)
OUTCOME_GUARDED (ids only; parser/truncation gate; deterministic evaluator)
JOURNAL (LLM reflection never marks outcomes verified)
EVIDENCE_LAYER (evidence verification_level is evidence-scoped, never outcome authority)
APPROVAL_LAYER (grants are consumed before spawn; approval never verifies outcomes)
LIFECYCLE (succeeded/failed semantics frozen with regression tests)
JOURNAL (routes to recordDecisionOutcome with the CP8A-013 markers)
